test_title: PYST 2: Selection Post (Matric Level) - GA (Held On 25 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question: Who is eligible to receive benefits under the Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) scheme?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Women from BPL households**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)** was launched by Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** on **May 1, 2016**, in **Ballia, Uttar Pradesh**. The scheme was introduced with the primary aim of providing **clean cooking fuel** like **LPG** to rural and deprived households.
 
• The eligibility for this scheme is specifically restricted to **women** who are at least **18 years** of age and belong to a **Below Poverty Line (BPL)** family. This ensures women's empowerment and protects their health from the hazards of smoke.
 
• The identification of beneficiaries is done through the **Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC) 2011** data. If a household is not covered under **SECC**, they can still be eligible if they fall under categories like **SC/ST** households or **Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY)**.
 
• Under the scheme, the **Central Government** provides financial assistance of **₹1600** for each **LPG connection**. This amount covers the security deposit of the cylinder, pressure regulator, booklet, and pipe.
 
• The **Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas** is the nodal ministry responsible for the implementation of this scheme across the **country**. It aims to replace traditional fuels like **firewood**, **coal**, and **cow-dung cakes** which cause severe respiratory diseases.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Ujjwala 2.0 (Phase 2):** Launched in **August 2021** from **Mahoba, Uttar Pradesh**, this version aimed to cover an additional **1 crore** beneficiaries. It simplified the application process by allowing **Self-Declaration** for **migrant workers** who do not have permanent address proof.
 
• **Expanded Coverage:** While the initial focus was strictly on **BPL** families, the scope was later expanded to include **Most Backward Classes (MBC)**, **Tea and Ex-Tea Garden tribes**, **Forest Dwellers**, and people residing in **River Islands**.
 
• **Health and Environmental Impact:** According to **WHO** reports, smoke inhaled by women using unclean fuel is equivalent to burning **400 cigarettes** in an hour. PMUY helps in reducing **Indoor Air Pollution** and contributes to **environmental conservation** by reducing deforestation.
 
• **Financial Incentives:** In **Ujjwala 2.0**, the **first refill** and a **hotplate (stove)** are provided **free of cost** to the beneficiaries, further reducing the financial burden on poor families.
 
• **Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT):** The subsidy for **LPG** refills is directly credited to the bank accounts of the beneficiaries under the **PAHAL (Pratyaksh Hanstantrit Labh)** scheme to prevent leakages and corruption.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Target Achievement:** The initial target of **5 crore** connections was achieved in **2018**, which was later revised to **8 crore** and successfully met by **September 2019**, seven months ahead of the **year** deadline.
 
• **Exclusions:** A household is ineligible if any member already possesses an **LPG connection** from any **Oil Marketing Company (OMC)** like **IOCL**, **BPCL**, or **HPCL**.
 
• **Safety Standards:** As part of the scheme, beneficiaries are provided with **safety clinics** and **education** on the safe usage of **LPG cylinders** to prevent accidental fire outbreaks in rural settings.
